name: buildmates
description: Meet builders through what you are working on now, with explicit privacy controls and reciprocal matching.

interface.shortDescription: Meet people through what you build
interface.longDescription: Buildmates turns user-approved summaries of current work into a living builder profile, relevant introductions, and lightweight shared rooms.
defaultPrompt: Install or resume Buildmates and guide me through the complete first run. Start by checking my setup state, use only context I approve, and take me through one next step at a time until my profile is reviewed and I have one useful next action.
Refresh my Work Pulse and find relevant builders.
Show my Buildmates connections and rooms.
